title: Christ as Wisdom and the types of his body
english: Through the wine and the bread, the members preach the types of the physical things of Christ.

He calls Christ Wisdom, her perceptible icon, proclaiming the visible wisdom and her commerce as a greeting before all things; and he is strong, setting nothing of the kind of evil or cunning against her, for presenting a clear knowledge through her words, she cries out with good report; she is well-known to all, and every precious thing is not worthy of her.
